final_message:
**Status:** Reproduced (on Linux; the Windows open-file limit is replaced by a lowered `ulimit -n`, so that part is simulated. The same failure also occurs at the machine's default limit with 22,000 files.)

No production code was changed.

**Expected:** `eslint ./ --fix` fixes every file with auto-fixable problems and exits 0.

**Actual:** `ESLint.outputFixes` crashes with the reported error and stack, and only some of the files get fixed:
```
Error: EMFILE: too many open files, open '/tmp/.../f553.js'
    at async open (node:internal/fs/promises:636:25)
    at async Object.writeFile (node:internal/fs/promises:1205:14)
    at async Promise.all (index 1005)
    at async ESLint.outputFixes (lib/eslint/eslint.js:533:3)
    at async Object.execute (lib/cli.js:637:4)
```
Exit status is 2. In the check below, 496 of 1500 files were left unfixed.

**Trigger:** The number of fixable files must reach the process's open-file limit. `outputFixes` starts a `fs.writeFile` for every fixed file at once with `Promise.all`, so the open handles pile up.
- With `ulimit -n 1024`, 1000 files pass and 1100 or more fail, so the threshold is the limit minus about 20.
- At the default limit of 20000, 22,000 files fail at `Promise.all (index 19979)`.
- Node raises its soft limit to the hard limit at startup, so the check has to set both limits (`ulimit -n`, not `ulimit -Sn`).

**Run:** `bash repro/emfile-fix.sh` from the repo root. It generates 1500 files with one `no-var` problem each in a temp dir and runs `eslint ./ --fix` under `ulimit -n 1024`. It exits 1 while any file stays unfixed or eslint exits non-zero. `FILES` and `LIMIT` env vars override the defaults.

**Passes when:**
- With a throwaway patch that made `outputFixes` write files one at a time, the check printed `PASS` and exited 0 with 0 of 1500 files unfixed. I reverted it.
- Below the limit it also passes: 1000 files at `ulimit -n 1024`.

**Reliability:** Deterministic. The check failed 10 of 10 runs.

**Artifacts:** `repro/emfile-fix.sh` in the repo working tree. It is the only change; `lib/` is untouched.
patch:
diff --git a/repro/emfile-fix.sh b/repro/emfile-fix.sh
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..bb3604c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/repro/emfile-fix.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,42 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Check for "eslint --fix throws EMFILE: too many open files" (ESLint.outputFixes
+# writes every fixed file at once with Promise.all).
+#
+# Expected (from the report): all files with auto-fixable problems are fixed.
+# Exits 0 when that holds, non-zero while the bug is present.
+#
+# FILES  number of fixable files to generate (default 1500)
+# LIMIT  open-file limit (ulimit -n) for the eslint process (default 1024).
+#        Set both soft and hard: node raises its soft limit to the hard limit.
+set -u
+
+FILES=${FILES:-1500}
+LIMIT=${LIMIT:-1024}
+REPO_ROOT=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)
+WORK=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
+
+# Fixture: FILES files that each contain one auto-fixable problem (no-var).
+FILES=$FILES WORK=$WORK node -e '
+const fs = require("fs");
+for (let i = 0; i < +process.env.FILES; i++) {
+    fs.writeFileSync(`${process.env.WORK}/f${i}.js`, "var a = 1;\nmodule.exports = a;\n");
+}
+fs.writeFileSync(`${process.env.WORK}/eslint.config.js`,
+    "module.exports = [{ rules: { \"no-var\": \"error\" } }];\n");
+' || { echo "fixture setup failed"; exit 99; }
+
+# The reporter's command: eslint ./ --fix
+( cd "$WORK" && ulimit -n "$LIMIT" && node "$REPO_ROOT/bin/eslint.js" ./ --fix ) >"$WORK/eslint.out" 2>&1
+status=$?
+
+unfixed=$(grep -l '^var ' "$WORK"/f*.js 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
+echo "eslint exit status: $status (open-file limit $LIMIT, $FILES fixable files)"
+echo "files still unfixed: $unfixed / $FILES"
+
+if [ "$status" -ne 0 ] || [ "$unfixed" -ne 0 ]; then
+    echo "FAIL: not all auto-fixable files were fixed. eslint output:"
+    head -20 "$WORK/eslint.out"
+    exit 1
+fi
+echo "PASS: all files fixed"
